title: [Room Ready](https://www.roblox.com/games/18952178718/Room-Ready)
description: Room Ready is a competitive building game where players must decorate a room to match a given theme. The game has been rescripted and its development has been stopped. Despite containing lots of bugs, it is signficantly more stable than its V1. The game was fully programmed by me and its white and blue identity was designed by me by taking heavy inspiration from INZOI.
